fields.meaning: Current player avatar world-position vector observed as native float32 X, Y, and Z coordinates and compared with the RIFT Lua player-coordinate source.

locator.method: For executable SHA 7C356C9DDE9E12FCBFF3C08D953B0630B48B1510A0FFB36E4EC164606E7B17BD, read the x64 pointer at main-module RVA 0x32E0200, then read float32 X/Y/Z from the resolved owner at offsets 0x320/0x324/0x328. Re-resolve for every sample; never reuse the absolute owner address.

invalidationConditions: A different RIFT executable SHA requires a new locator assessment; patch survival is not established.
A missing process, stale process start identity, failed pointer read, nonfinite value, or subnormal startup value makes the observation unavailable rather than zero or cached.
An absolute owner address is session state and must be freshly resolved from the module-relative root.
A disagreement with an independently advancing Lua player-coordinate source requires a new contrary assessment.
